-- Inserir dados MARÇO/2026 - MORUMBI (850 clientes)
INSERT INTO cashbarberAtendimentos (
  tenantId, empresaSlug, clienteId, clienteNome, profissionalId, profissionalNome,
  servicoTipo, valor, dataAtendimento, mes, ano, status
)
SELECT 
  1 as tenantId,
  'MORUMBI' as empresaSlug,
  CONCAT('cli_morumbi_mar_', ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.id)) as clienteId,
  CONCAT('Cliente Morumbi Mar ', ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.id)) as clienteNome,
  CONCAT('prof_', FLOOR(RAND() * 4)) as profissionalId,
  ELT(FLOOR(RAND() * 4) + 1, 'João Silva', 'Carlos Santos', 'Pedro Oliveira', 'Lucas Costa') as profissionalNome,
  ELT(FLOOR(RAND() * 4) + 1, 'Corte', 'Barba', 'Corte + Barba', 'Pigmentação') as servicoTipo,
  ELT(FLOOR(RAND() * 4) + 1, 30, 25, 50, 40) as valor,
  DATE_ADD('2026-03-01', INTERVAL FLOOR(RAND() * 28) DAY) as dataAtendimento,
  3 as mes,
  2026 as ano,
  'concluido' as status
FROM (
  SELECT 1 as id UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
) t1
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
) t2
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
) t3
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
) t4
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
) t5
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
) t6
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5
) t7
LIMIT 850;
